Date: 2027-06-02T08:04:00-07:00

Hi Luca — thanks for sending. Quick note from our side: finance has flagged a signatory name mismatch between the W-8 and the registry excerpt. We need to clear this before the PO can be issued.

Kimberly (cc'd) runs payments/POs — Kim, can you confirm the minimum set of docs Procurement needs to release the PO? From previous cases: notarized Certificate of Incumbency that ties Marco De Luca to the signatory name used on the W-8, or a board resolution plus a government ID/passport for the signee. Also a bank letter matching entity name for ACH setup.

Luca — if you can provide either the notarized COI or the board resolution + ID, and the bank letter, we can prioritize release. If DocuSign is preferable, we can accept final executed copies there too.

Thanks,
Mateo
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Luca Bianchi <luca@tributary.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-03T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tributary onboarding: signatory mismatch & supporting tax evidence

Luca — quick checklist from Procurement to clear PO hold:

- Notarized Certificate of Incumbency (scanned PDF) showing Marco De Luca as authorized signatory, OR a board resolution naming the signee + a government photo ID for Marco.
- The signed W-8BEN-E (we have the PDF you sent). Please confirm the sign date.
- Bank letter on bank letterhead confirming account ownership by Tributary Labs and the account details for ACH. Bank letter should be dated within the last 90 days.
- Confirmation whether Tributary is claiming treaty benefits; if yes, provide a short explanation of revenue type tied to the treaty claim.

Once we have the notarized COI (or alt docs) and the bank letter, Procurement can complete the vendor record and issue the PO. If any of these will be delayed >7 business days, tell us and we can discuss a conditional PO for limited spend.

Kimberly Park
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Luca Bianchi <luca@tributary.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-05T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tributary onboarding: signatory mismatch & supporting tax evidence

Hi Kimberly and Mateo,

Thanks for the clear checklist. We're pulling the notarized Certificate of Incumbency and a bank letter — both should be ready by early next week.

Regarding the treaty claim: Tributary licenses pre-trained model embeddings and charges a usage license to Redwood. The royalties/article mapping comes from our legal team — we will include a one-paragraph explanation signed by counsel.

One more question: the W-8 was signed by Marco De Luca using the short name on his passport ("M. De Luca"). Would a notarized attestation from our company legal officer confirming that "M. De Luca" and "Marco De Luca" are the same person be sufficient in lieu of a COI?

Best,
Luca

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Luca Bianchi <luca@tributary.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-07T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tributary onboarding: signatory mismatch & supporting tax evidence

Luca — quick legal input. A notarized attestation from your legal officer is acceptable only if it includes the following clause:

- Explicit statement tying the abbreviated name to the full legal name ("M. De Luca" == "Marco De Luca")
- Confirmation of the signatory's authority to bind the entity for tax documents
- Notary stamp and signature with date

However, for final vendor record and to avoid IRS/withholding risk, our preference is a notarized Certificate of Incumbency. The COI is standard and reduces downstream friction with tax and payments. If you can provide a COI, bank letter, and the signed W-8 we will release the PO the same day we confirm the documents.

We'll accept documents via DocuSign or a secure upload link. If helpful, Mateo/Kim can share the DocuSign template link.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
attachments referenced: Bank_Letter_Tributary.pdf, Certificate_of_Incumbency_Tributary.pdf, W-8BEN-E_Tributary_signed.pdf
